title:
Before an agent
touches your money.
vo: Before an agent touches your money, what should it have to prove?
direction: Paper ground. A single rule draws across the frame, stopping at a boundary. The word permission sits beyond it. The question must read muted.

subtitle: Registrations indexed on BNB Smart Chain
vo: Two hundred and ninety-eight thousand, eight hundred and seventeen registrations. A name on chain. But can you hire one? We tried.
direction: Large number, then a smaller evidence rail. Do not imply these are unique operators. Homepage/API source appears beside the number.

subtitle: Third-party conformance runs
vo: Six hundred and eighty-four conformance runs against third-party agents. Published tests. Recorded outcomes.
direction: The population count exits. New sample counter occupies a different field, explicitly marked test runs, not agents.

subtitle: Passes in these tests
direction: 1.5 seconds of digital silence before speech; 600 ms after. Zero is already visible during silence. No sound-effect hit.

title:
Failure to answer
is an outcome.
vo: Five hundred and one could not answer through an interface we could address. That is a result of these tests. Not a verdict on every agent.
direction: Show the 501 no-answer subset and the remaining 183 runs as separately labelled measured and derived values. One restrained comparison, never an ecosystem failure percentage.

title:
Evidence before
authority.
direction: Use the existing mark as a brief boundary wipe; open onto the daylight product. Wordmark is original artwork.

title:
Start with
what you hold.
vo: Start with what you hold. Paste an address. No wallet connection. Marque reads the position from chain, shows its health factor, and publishes the block behind the number.
direction: Actual address input and successful read, then crop to the Venus rule and its provenance. Do not voice a transient health factor. Scouting still is provisional; recapture after voice selection.

title:
An agent.
Its evidence.
vo: Find an agent for the job. Compare its interface, price and test record. Duplicate identities are grouped together. Our reference agents are labelled as ours. Preview an answer before paying.
direction: Real category filter, two agent selections, compare tray, free preview. Keep reference-agent badge in the crop. Match the visible action to each phrase, not a held whole-page overview.

title:
The answer
has to hold.
vo: The standard checks facts and the policy supplied with the task. Same pinned chain state. Field by field. Passes and failures stay public. A directory that only listed its passes would be a brochure.
direction: Readable actual MCS field and tolerance, a reference pass and a named third-party failure. The evidence labels state different historical blocks; do not imply they are the same trial.

title:
Permission
has an edge.
vo: Then set the limits. Which contracts. Which functions. How much. Until when. Marque checks those limits before its signing path proceeds. The demo charter is on testnet: grant it, inspect the transaction, and revoke it.
direction: The sole dim to cockpit. Actual testnet grant and revoke after voice lock. Tight readable cap and expiry, scope list, then confirmation. No mainnet write. No fabricated confirmation animation.

title:
The run leaves
a record.
vo: The receipt records the quote, the permission, the execution and the output. Open the evidence behind it.
direction: Real archived run receipt with actual anchor status. Do not label archived events as arriving live. Require receipt source before final capture.

title:
Out of range.
Back in range.
vo: And this is the mainnet demonstration. A deliberately narrow PancakeSwap position, re-centred under a sixty-dollar cap. The before, the after, and the transactions are published. You can check what changed.
direction: Exact archived before/after ticks in a labelled explanatory range graphic, matched to the real proof page. Orchestral payoff begins when the new range encloses the recorded current tick. Highlight hashes as links, not tiny wallpaper.

title:
Publish the
unfinished work, too.
vo: The Ledger publishes cost, timing and quality grades, including what is still unfinished. Accountability includes our own work.
direction: Real incomplete status plainly legible. No unsupported speed, quality or cost victory. Keep this beat brief, confident and literal.

title:
Ask for evidence.
Then give permission.
vo: Do not hire a registration. Ask for evidence. Set the limits. Inspect the result. Marque.
direction: Opening rule returns with its boundary intact. Existing lockup and marque.trade. Final four seconds hold the address. Solo piano resolve.
